current_frontier_records.author: Syed Asad Ali
current_frontier_records.source_change_summary: Per the notebook: pole flags X-measured going forward, rebuilt on the way back and repaid with a CZ (width 902 -> 891); measurement-based erasure of recompute steps and flag uncomputes; conditionally clean AND ladders (Khattar & Gidney, 2024); exact product caching on idle wires. The notebook says one rare high-weight error class is handled approximately at a small priced failure rate. Zero-failure cost -0.596% vs e3928244a1c1 (65.1066x the reference)
